newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: NAB cuts Australian credit card rates.
newsitem.headline: NAB cuts Australian credit card rates.

text.p: National Australia Bank (NAB) said on Friday it would cut credit card interest rates by 0.6 percentage points effective August 18.
The rate on NAB's MasterCard, Visa and Bankcard would be cut to 15.25 percent from 15.85 percent. The rate on NAB's Fee Free Bankcard would be cut to 14.35 percent from 14.95.
Rates on Gold cards remain unchanged at 14.85 percent.
The reduction in NAB's credit card rates follow the Reserve Bank of Australia's 0.5 percentage point cut in official cash rates on July 30.
